typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		Market as string,
		{Subscriber No} as string,
		{Medicaid No} as string,
		{First Name} as string,
		{Last Name} as string,
		Address as string,
		Phone as string,
		{Birth Date} as string,
		{Age Band} as string,
		{Age In Years} as string,
		{Age In Months} as string,
		Service as string,
		{Due From Date} as string,
		{Due To Date} as string,
		{Minimum Count} as string,
		{Schedule Desc} as string,
		{Previous Service Dates Given} as string,
		AffNum as string,
		{PCP Full Name} as string,
		{Provider Last Seen} as string,
		{Provider Last Seen Address} as string,
		{Provider Last Seen Phone} as string,
		{Last Service Date} as string,
		Gender as string,
		LANGUAGE as string,
		HOHFamilyLink as string,
		ProvTaxID as string,
		GroupName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'SELECT DISTINCT      CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PML.Market) AS Market   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(15), PML.Member) AS \'Subscriber No\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), PML.MedicaidNo) AS \'Medicaid No\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), PML.FirstName) AS \'First Name\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), PML.LastName) AS \'Last Name\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.[Address]) AS Address   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), PML.Phone) AS Phone   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PML.BirthDate) AS \'Birth Date\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PML.AgeBand) AS \'Age Band\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.AgeInYears) AS \'Age In Years\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.AgeInMonths) AS \'Age In Months\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(20), PML.[Service]) AS Service   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PML.DueFromDate) AS \'Due From Date\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PML.DueToDate) AS \'Due To Date\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.MinimumCount) AS \'Minimum Count\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(150), PML.ScheduleDesc) AS \'Schedule Desc\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000), PML.PreviousSvcDates) AS \'Previous Service Dates Given\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(50), PML.AffNum) AS AffNum   ,CASE        WHEN ProviderFullName = \'\' THEN \'No Provider Name\' ELSE ProviderFullName  END AS \'PCP Full Name\'  ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), PML.Provider_TaxID) AS \'ProvTaxID\' ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(100), PML.Group_Name) AS \'GroupName\'   ,(select top 1 MC.ProviderName from EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims MC where MC.ClaimID = PML.ClaimID) AS \'Provider Last Seen\'  ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(1000),(select top 1 MC.ProviderAddress from EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims MC where MC.ClaimID = PML.ClaimID)) AS \'Provider Last Seen Address\'   ,(select top 1 MC.ProviderPhone from EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberClaims MC where MC.ClaimID = PML.ClaimID) AS \'Provider Last Seen Phone\'   ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10), LastServiceDate) AS \'Last Service Date\'   ,CM.SEX \'Gender\'   ,CM.[LANGUAGE]    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR(12), CM.HOHFamilyLink) AS \'HOHFamilyLink\'  FROM  EPSDT.dbo.EPSDTProactiveMemberList PML(nolock)   JOIN  EPSDTCURRENTMEMBER CM     ON   PML.MEMBER = LEFT(CM.Member,9)   AND   PML.PROGNUM = CM.PROGNUM    AND   PML.MARKET = CM.MARKET WHERE  PML.ProgNum = \'DC\'      AND  AgeBand = ?      AND  DUETODATE < DATEADD(DD,60,GETDATE()) ORDER BY 1, 2, 12, 13, 14',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource derive({Copy of Phone} = toString(Phone),
		{Copy of ProvTaxID} = toString(ProvTaxID),
		{Copy of Address} = toString(Address),
		{Copy of Gender} = toString(Gender),
		{Copy of HOHFamilyLink} = toString(HOHFamilyLink),
		{Copy of GroupName} = toString(GroupName),
		{Copy of LANGUAGE} = toString(LANGUAGE),
		{Copy of Market} = toString(Market),
		{Copy of Service} = toString(Service),
		{Copy of AffNum} = toString(AffNum)) ~> DataConversion
ExcelDestination derive({} = {}) ~> ExcelDestinationErrorReformat
ExcelDestinationErrorReformat sink(input(
		Provider_Last_Seen as string,
		ErrorColumn as integer,
		Birth_Date as string,
		Address as string,
		Provider_Last_Seen_Address as string,
		Copy_of_Due_To_Date as string,
		Age_In_Years as string,
		Age_In_Months as string,
		First_Name as string,
		Copy_of_Minimum_Count as string,
		Medicaid_No as string,
		Phone as string,
		Subscriber_No as string,
		Copy_of_Provider_Last_Seen_Address as string,
		Due_From_Date as string,
		Copy_of_Phone as string,
		Copy_of_Last_Service_Date as string,
		Minimum_Count as string,
		Copy_of_Birth_Date as string,
		Copy_of_Due_From_Date as string,
		Previous_Service_Dates_Given as string,
		Provider_Last_Seen_Phone as string,
		Copy_of_Provider_Last_Seen as string,
		Copy_of_Market as string,
		Service as string,
		PCP_Full_Name as string,
		Copy_of_Subscriber_No as string,
		Market as string,
		Copy_of_Address as string,
		Last_Service_Date as string,
		Copy_of_Previous_Service_Dates_Given as string,
		Copy_of_Service as string,
		Copy_of_PCP_Full_Name as string,
		AffNum as string,
		Copy_of_First_Name as string,
		Schedule_Desc as string,
		Age_Band as string,
		Last_Name as string,
		Copy_of_Age_Band as string,
		Copy_of_Age_In_Months as string,
		Due_To_Date as string,
		Copy_of_Age_In_Years as string,
		Copy_of_Last_Name as string,
		Copy_of_Provider_Last_Seen_Phone as string,
		Copy_of_AffNum as string,
		Copy_of_Schedule_Desc as string,
		ErrorCode as integer,
		Copy_of_Medicaid_No as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Provider_Last_Seen = {Provider Last Seen},
		ErrorColumn,
		Birth_Date = {Birth Date},
		Address,
		Provider_Last_Seen_Address = {Provider Last Seen Address},
		Copy_of_Due_To_Date = {Copy of Due To Date},
		Age_In_Years = {Age In Years},
		Age_In_Months = {Age In Months},
		First_Name = {First Name},
		Copy_of_Minimum_Count = {Copy of Minimum Count},
		Medicaid_No = {Medicaid No},
		Phone,
		Subscriber_No = {Subscriber No},
		Copy_of_Provider_Last_Seen_Address = {Copy of Provider Last Seen Address},
		Due_From_Date = {Due From Date},
		Copy_of_Phone = {Copy of Phone},
		Copy_of_Last_Service_Date = {Copy of Last Service Date},
		Minimum_Count = {Minimum Count},
		Copy_of_Birth_Date = {Copy of Birth Date},
		Copy_of_Due_From_Date = {Copy of Due From Date},
		Previous_Service_Dates_Given = {Previous Service Dates Given},
		Provider_Last_Seen_Phone = {Provider Last Seen Phone},
		Copy_of_Provider_Last_Seen = {Copy of Provider Last Seen},
		Copy_of_Market = {Copy of Market},
		Service,
		PCP_Full_Name = {PCP Full Name},
		Copy_of_Subscriber_No = {Copy of Subscriber No},
		Market,
		Copy_of_Address = {Copy of Address},
		Last_Service_Date = {Last Service Date},
		Copy_of_Previous_Service_Dates_Given = {Copy of Previous Service Dates Given},
		Copy_of_Service = {Copy of Service},
		Copy_of_PCP_Full_Name = {Copy of PCP Full Name},
		AffNum,
		Copy_of_First_Name = {Copy of First Name},
		Schedule_Desc = {Schedule Desc},
		Age_Band = {Age Band},
		Last_Name = {Last Name},
		Copy_of_Age_Band = {Copy of Age Band},
		Copy_of_Age_In_Months = {Copy of Age In Months},
		Due_To_Date = {Due To Date},
		Copy_of_Age_In_Years = {Copy of Age In Years},
		Copy_of_Last_Name = {Copy of Last Name},
		Copy_of_Provider_Last_Seen_Phone = {Copy of Provider Last Seen Phone},
		Copy_of_AffNum = {Copy of AffNum},
		Copy_of_Schedule_Desc = {Copy of Schedule Desc},
		ErrorCode,
		Copy_of_Medicaid_No = {Copy of Medicaid No})) ~> FlatFileDestination
ExcelDestinationErrorReformat derive({} = {}) ~> ExcelDestination0
ExcelDestination0 sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		{} = Provider_Last_Seen)) ~> ExcelDestinationERROROUTPUTFILE
